definitions.explanation: not complete or whole; leaving things unfinished
lacking commitment or thoroughness; neither one thing nor another
a number that is not a round number

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{半端|はんぱ}にしないで。
{半端|はんぱ}な{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: You can't continue with a half-hearted attitude.

examples.japanese: {半端|はんぱ}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
examples.english: Don't give opinions based on incomplete knowledge.

examples.japanese: {半端|はんぱ}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧だ。
examples.notes: ～じゃない inverts meaning to 'not half-hearted' = extreme

examples.japanese: {半端|はんぱ}な⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧になってしまった。
examples.english: It ended up being an odd number.

examples.japanese: {半端|はんぱ}⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安売|やすう}り→安売り：07779_yasuuri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They're selling leftover/odd items at a discount.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {半端|はんぱ}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ - "not half-hearted" = extreme, incredible, tremendous
  (This inversion creates emphasis, like English "no joke")
- {半端|はんぱ}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - same as above (more casual/modern)
- {中途|ちゅうと}{半端|はんぱ} - half-baked, incomplete (stronger criticism)

USAGE:
{半端|はんぱ} often carries a negative connotation, implying a lack of commitment or thoroughness.

OTHER USES:
- {半端|はんぱ}⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ - odd items, leftovers, remnants (in retail)
- {半端|はんぱ}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ - awkward time (neither early nor late)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧ - thorough (opposite quality)
